subject.title: Suppress duplicate session lock timeout replies

question: Should reply-run ownership and lock-timeout classification become a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or remain an internal agents-runtime detail?
rationale: The branch updates the generated Plugin SDK API baseline while exposing a lock-internal classifier; choosing a permanent SDK surface requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Move the classifier behind the core reply handler and remove the generated SDK baseline change.

options.title: Adopt the SDK API
options.body: Explicitly approve and document the new lock-timeout owner contract, including its stability and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal
recommendation.body: Move the classifier behind the core reply handler and remove the generated SDK baseline change.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history could not be inspected to route this API decision to a named contributor.
